records.literal_gloss: And approached all [the] commanders of the forces, and Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from small and unto great,

en.L: Then all the commanders of the forces came near, with Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the small to the great,
en.B: Then all the commanders of the forces came forward, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, with all the people from the least to the greatest.
en.R: Then all the army commanders came to Jeremiah. Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah were with them. All the people came too, from the least important to the most important.

es.L: Entonces se acercaron todos los jefes de las tropas, y Johanán hijo de Carea, y Jezanías hijo de Osaías, y todo el pueblo, desde el menor hasta el mayor,
es.B: Entonces se acercaron todos los jefes de las tropas, entre ellos Johanán hijo de Carea y Jezanías hijo de Osaías, con todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande.
es.R: Entonces todos los jefes del ejército vinieron a ver a Jeremías. Johanán hijo de Carea y Jezanías hijo de Osaías iban con ellos. También vino todo el pueblo, desde el menos importante hasta el más importante.

fr.L: Alors tous les chefs des troupes s’approchèrent, avec Yohanân fils de Qaréah et Yezania fils de Hoshaya, et tout le peuple, du plus petit jusqu’au plus grand,
fr.B: Alors tous les chefs des troupes s’avancèrent, parmi lesquels Yohanân fils de Qaréah et Yezania fils de Hoshaya, avec tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand.
fr.R: Alors tous les chefs de l’armée sont venus trouver Jérémie. Yohanân fils de Qaréah et Yezania fils de Hoshaya étaient avec eux. Tout le peuple est venu aussi, des plus humbles aux plus importants.

sw.L: Ndipo wakuu wote wa majeshi wakakaribia, pamoja na Yohana mwana wa Karea na Yezania mwana wa Hoshaya, na watu wote tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa,
sw.B: Kisha wakuu wote wa majeshi wakaja mbele, pamoja na Yohana mwana wa Karea na Yezania mwana wa Hoshaya, na watu wote tangu aliye mdogo hadi aliye mkubwa.
sw.R: Kisha makamanda wote wa jeshi wakamjia Yeremia. Yohana mwana wa Karea na Yezania mwana wa Hoshaya walikuwa pamoja nao. Watu wote wakaja pia, tangu wasio na cheo hadi wenye vyeo vikubwa.

vi.L: Bấy giờ tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính, cùng Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và Giê-xa-nia con trai Hô-sa-gia, và cả dân chúng từ nhỏ đến lớn, đều đến gần,
vi.B: Bấy giờ tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính, trong đó có Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và Giê-xa-nia con trai Hô-sa-gia, cùng cả dân chúng từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất, đều đến gần.
vi.R: Bấy giờ tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân đội đến gặp Giê-rê-mi. Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và Giê-xa-nia con trai Hô-sa-gia cũng ở với họ. Cả dân chúng cũng đến, từ người thấp hèn nhất đến người quan trọng nhất.

ko.L: 그때에 모든 군대 지휘관과 가레아의 아들 요하난과 호사야의 아들 여사냐와 작은 자부터 큰 자까지 모든 백성이 다가와서,
ko.B: 그때에 모든 군대 지휘관이 가레아의 아들 요하난과 호사야의 아들 여사냐를 비롯하여, 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성과 함께 나아왔다.
ko.R: 그때에 모든 군대 지휘관이 예레미야에게 왔다. 가레아의 아들 요하난과 호사야의 아들 여사냐도 함께 왔다. 지위가 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성도 왔다.

pt.L: Então todos os chefes das tropas se aproximaram, com Joanã, filho de Careá, e Jezanias, filho de Hosaías, e todo o povo, desde o pequeno até o grande,
pt.B: Então todos os comandantes das tropas se aproximaram, entre eles Joanã, filho de Careá, e Jezanias, filho de Hosaías, com todo o povo, do menor ao maior.
pt.R: Então todos os comandantes do exército foram falar com Jeremias. Joanã, filho de Careá, e Jezanias, filho de Hosaías, estavam com eles. Todo o povo também foi, desde os mais simples até os mais importantes.

am.L: የጭፍሮቹም አለቆች ሁሉ፣ የቃሬያ ልጅ ዮሐናንና የሆሻያ ልጅ ይዛንያ፣ ከትንሹም እስከ ትልቁ ድረስ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ቀረቡ፤
am.B: ከዚያም የቃሬያን ልጅ ዮሐናንንና የሆሻያን ልጅ ይዛንያን ጨምሮ የጭፍሮቹ አለቆች ሁሉ ከትንሹ እስከ ትልቁ ድረስ ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጋር ወደ ፊት ቀረቡ።

hi.L: तब सेनाओं के सब प्रधान, और कारेह का पुत्र योहानान और होशायाह का पुत्र यज़न्याह, और छोटे से लेकर बड़े तक सब लोग पास आए,
hi.B: तब सेनाओं के सब प्रधान आगे आए, जिनमें कारेह का पुत्र योहानान और होशायाह का पुत्र यज़न्याह भी थे, और उनके साथ छोटे से लेकर बड़े तक सब लोग।
hi.R: तब सेना के सब प्रधान यिर्मयाह के पास आए। कारेह का पुत्र योहानान और होशायाह का पुत्र यज़न्याह भी उनके साथ थे। सब लोग भी आए, सबसे छोटे से लेकर सबसे बड़े तक।

ru.L: И подошли все начальники войск, и Иоанан, сын Карея, и Иезания, сын Гошаии, и весь народ от малого и до великого,
ru.B: Тогда подошли все начальники войск, а с ними Иоанан, сын Карея, и Иезания, сын Гошаии, и весь народ, от самого малого до самого великого.
ru.R: Тогда все военачальники пришли к Иеремии. С ними были Иоанан, сын Карея, и Иезания, сын Гошаии. Пришёл и весь народ, от самых простых людей до самых важных.

ja.L: そして、すべての軍の長たちと、カレアの子ヨハナンと、ホシャヤの子ヤアザンヤと、小さい者から大きい者まですべての民が近づいて来て、
ja.B: すると、すべての軍の司令官たちが、カレアの子ヨハナンとホシャヤの子ヤアザンヤを含めて、身分の低い者から高い者まですべての民と共に、進み出た。
ja.R: そこで、すべての軍の司令官たちが、エレミヤのところに来ました。カレアの息子ヨハナンと、ホシャヤの息子ヤアザンヤも一緒でした。身分の低い人から高い人まで、すべての人々も来ました。

uk.L: Тоді підійшли всі воєначальники військ, і Йоханан, син Кареаха, і Єзанія, син Гошаї, і весь народ від малого до великого,
uk.B: Тоді підійшли всі воєначальники військ, серед них Йоханан, син Кареаха, і Єзанія, син Гошаї, і з ними весь народ від найменшого до найбільшого.
uk.R: Тоді всі воєначальники прийшли до Єремії. З ними були Йоханан, син Кареаха, і Єзанія, син Гошаї. Прийшов і весь народ, від найменш важливих до найважливіших.

decisions.choice: the commanders of the forces and Johanan: the officers who had gathered at Mizpah and rescued the captives from Ishmael
decisions.reason: These are the army officers who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah (40:7-8). After Ishmael murdered Gedaliah, Johanan and the commanders freed the people Ishmael had taken and brought them to Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem, on the way to Egypt, because they feared what Babylon would do (41:11-18). This chapter goes on from there.

decisions.choice: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, as the Hebrew reads here
alternatives: Azariah son of Hoshaiah, as the Hebrew reads at 43:2
Azariah, as the Greek translation reads here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names this leader Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah. In 43:2, where the same leaders reply to Jeremiah, the Hebrew has Azariah son of Hoshaiah, and the Greek translation (the Septuagint, where this chapter is chapter 49) is said to have Azariah here as well. The two names may belong to one man, or one form may have come in from the other in copying. A Jezaniah son of the Maacathite is named among the commanders in 40:8 (Jaazaniah in 2 Kings 25:23), but his father is not Hoshaiah, so he may be someone else. The Hebrew is followed. The description of the Greek is from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: from the small to the great: everyone, whatever their rank
decisions.reason: The pair takes in the whole people, from the least important to the most important (6:13; 8:10; 2 Kings 25:26). The request comes from everyone, not from the leaders alone.

decisions.choice: a comma at the end of the verse (Literal)
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on into verse 2, where the people speak. Balanced and Readable end the sentence here.

decisions.choice: came to Jeremiah; army commanders; least important to the most important
decisions.reason: Readable names Jeremiah, whom they approach (verse 2), and explains "small" and "great" as rank.

decisions.choice: "tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa" (L, B); "tangu wasio na cheo hadi wenye vyeo vikubwa" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 25:26 in Swahili for "from the small to the great", meaning everyone whatever their rank.

decisions.choice: Giê-xa-nia con trai Hô-sa-gia
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here reads Jezaniah; the Greek and 43:2 have Azariah. Vietnamese follows the Hebrew, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "작은 자부터 큰 자까지" (L); "낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지" (B); "지위가 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지" (R)
decisions.reason: As published in 2 Kings 25:26, so the phrase reads the same through Jeremiah 42-44.

decisions.choice: desde o pequeno até o grande (L), do menor ao maior (B), desde os mais simples até os mais importantes (R)
decisions.reason: The pair (m3) keeps the wording 2 Kings 25:26 gives it in Portuguese at each level, in this chapter and the next (verse 8; 44:12). "Jezanias, filho de Hosaías" is kept as the Hebrew has it here (m2).

decisions.choice: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah is "የሆሻያ ልጅ ይዛንያ" (the form of 40:8); "from the small to the great" is "ከትንሹ እስከ ትልቁ", as 2 Kings 25:26.
decisions.reason: One spelling of the name through chapters 40-43, and the phrase of the Kings parallel where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: होशायाह का पुत्र यज़न्याह
decisions.reason: Jezaniah as in 40:8 (यज़न्याह); his father Hoshaiah is होशायाह, as Nehemiah 12:32. Here he is called son of Hoshaiah, in 40:8 son of the Maacathite.

decisions.choice: "Иезания, сын Гошаии"
decisions.reason: Jezaniah keeps the form of 40:8; Hoshaiah takes the form of Nehemiah 12:32 in this translation (m2).

decisions.choice: "от малого и до великого" (L); "от самого малого до самого великого" (B); "от самых простых людей до самых важных" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of 2 Kings 25:26 in this translation for "from the small to the great" (m3).

decisions.choice: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah "ホシャヤの子ヤアザンヤ" (the name as 40:8 and 2KI 25:23; Hoshaiah new).
decisions.reason: m2: the Hebrew name is kept (the spelling of 40:8, written as the 2 Kings form of the name); 43:2 has Azariah, which the footnote explains.

decisions.choice: miqqaton ve'ad gadol "小さい者から大きい者まで" (L), "身分の低い者から高い者まで" (B, R), as 2KI 25:26.
decisions.reason: m3: everyone, whatever their rank.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַנָּבִ֗יא תִּפָּל־נָ֤א תְחִנָּתֵ֨נוּ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל בַּעֲדֵ֨נוּ֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּעַ֖ד כָּל־הַשְּׁאֵרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּֽי־נִשְׁאַ֤רְנוּ מְעַט֙ מֵֽהַרְבֵּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֵינֶ֖יךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֹתָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and they said to Jeremiah the prophet: let fall please our supplication before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God for all the remnant the this, for we are left a few from many, as your eyes [are] seeing us,

en.L: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, "Please let our plea fall before you, and pray for us to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, for all this remnant; for we are left, a few out of many, as your eyes see us,
en.B: They said to the prophet Jeremiah, "Please hear our request, and pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for us, for all this remnant. There were many of us, but only a few are left, as you can see for yourself.
en.R: They said to the prophet Jeremiah, "Please listen to what we ask. Pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for us, for all of us who are left. Once we were many, but now only a few of us are left, as you can see.

es.L: y dijeron a Jeremías el profeta: «Caiga, por favor, nuestra súplica delante de ti, y ora por nosotros {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, por todo este remanente; porque hemos quedado pocos de muchos, como tus ojos nos ven,
es.B: Le dijeron al profeta Jeremías: «Por favor, escucha nuestra petición y ora {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios por nosotros, por todo este remanente. Éramos muchos, pero solo quedamos unos pocos, como tú mismo puedes ver.
es.R: Le dijeron al profeta Jeremías: «Por favor, escucha lo que te pedimos. Ora {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios por nosotros, por todos los que quedamos. Antes éramos muchos, pero ahora solo quedamos unos pocos, como puedes ver.

fr.L: et ils dirent à Jérémie le prophète : « Que notre supplication tombe donc devant toi, et prie pour nous {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, pour tout ce reste ; car nous sommes restés peu nombreux, de nombreux que nous étions, comme tes yeux nous voient,
fr.B: Ils dirent au prophète Jérémie : « Accueille, s’il te plaît, notre demande, et prie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour nous, pour tout ce reste. Nous étions nombreux, mais il n’en reste que peu, comme tu le vois toi-même.
fr.R: Ils ont dit au prophète Jérémie : « S’il te plaît, écoute ce que nous te demandons. Prie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour nous, pour nous tous qui restons. Autrefois, nous étions nombreux, mais maintenant il ne reste que peu d’entre nous, comme tu le vois.

sw.L: wakamwambia Yeremia nabii, "Tafadhali dua yetu ianguke mbele yako, utuombee kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwa ajili ya mabaki haya yote; kwa maana tumebaki wachache kati ya wengi, kama macho yako yanavyotuona,
sw.B: Wakamwambia nabii Yeremia, "Tafadhali sikia ombi letu, utuombee kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwa ajili ya mabaki haya yote. Tulikuwa wengi, lakini wamebaki wachache tu, kama unavyoona mwenyewe.
sw.R: Wakamwambia nabii Yeremia, "Tafadhali sikiliza tunachokuomba. Utuombee kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, kwa ajili yetu sote tuliobaki. Hapo zamani tulikuwa wengi, lakini sasa tumebaki wachache tu, kama unavyoona.

vi.L: và nói với nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi: "Xin cho lời khẩn cầu của chúng tôi thấu đến trước mặt ông, và xin ông cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ông, cho chúng tôi, cho tất cả những người sót lại này; vì chúng tôi chỉ còn lại một ít trong số đông, như chính mắt ông thấy chúng tôi đây,
vi.B: Họ nói với nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi: "Xin ông nghe lời thỉnh cầu của chúng tôi, và cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ông, cho chúng tôi, cho tất cả những người sót lại này. Trước kia chúng tôi đông, nhưng nay chỉ còn lại một ít, như chính ông thấy đó.
vi.R: Họ nói với nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi: "Xin ông nghe điều chúng tôi xin. Hãy cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của ông, cho chúng tôi, cho tất cả những người còn sống sót. Trước kia chúng tôi đông, nhưng bây giờ chỉ còn lại một ít người, như ông thấy đó.

ko.L: 예언자 예레미야에게 말했다. "우리의 간구가 당신 앞에 떨어지게 해 주십시오. 그리고 우리를 위하여, 이 남은 자 모두를 위하여 당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도해 주십시오. 당신의 눈이 우리를 보고 있듯이, 우리는 많은 사람 가운데서 조금만 남았습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 예언자 예레미야에게 말했다. "우리의 간청을 들어 주십시오. 우리를 위하여, 여기 남은 이 모든 사람을 위하여 당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도해 주십시오. 보시다시피 우리는 많던 사람 가운데서 겨우 몇 사람만 남았습니다.

decisions.choice: let our plea fall before you: please accept our request
decisions.reason: A request is pictured as falling or being laid down before the person asked, as one bows before a superior. The same phrase is used for a plea to the king in 37:20 and 38:26, and for prayer to God in 36:7. The people show Jeremiah great respect.

decisions.choice: the LORD your God: the people speak of the LORD as Jeremiah's God
decisions.reason: They say "your God", as if the LORD were the prophet's God more than theirs. Jeremiah answers that he will pray to "your God", the God of all of them (verse 4), and in verse 6 the people say "the LORD our God". The shift of pronouns runs through the chapter and returns in verse 20.

decisions.choice: remnant: the few people left in Judah after the fall of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The word means what is left over. Here it is the small group that remained in the land after the exile of 586 BC and the murder of Gedaliah (40:11, 15). The prophets speak of a remnant both as the sign of a disaster and as the seed of hope (Isaiah 10:20-22).

decisions.choice: hear our request (B); listen to what we ask (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m1); Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: There were many of us, but only a few are left
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "we are left a few from many" is unfolded into two clauses. Balanced and Readable end the sentence here, and verse 3 follows as a new sentence; Literal keeps one sentence with a comma.

decisions.choice: tu Dios (Jeremiah addressed as tú)
decisions.reason: The people speak to Jeremiah alone, so "your God" is singular here and in verses 3 and 5; the plural_you spans begin when Jeremiah answers all of them (verse 4).

decisions.choice: "ce reste" (L, B); "nous tous qui restons" (R)
decisions.reason: *Sheʾerit* is "le reste" at Literal and Balanced, as the French terms note sets for the remnant; Readable says who they are.

decisions.choice: ông (the people to Jeremiah); chúng tôi
decisions.reason: The commanders and people speak to the prophet as "ông", the respectful word used for him through these chapters; "your God" is "Đức Chúa Trời của ông".

decisions.choice: The people ask Jeremiah in 합쇼체; Jeremiah answers them in 하오체 ("들었소", "알려 주겠소") and frames God's word with "말씀하시오" (verse 9)
decisions.reason: The people come as petitioners to a prophet; Jeremiah speaks to the assembly as a grown man to grown men, while God's own words inside his speech keep 해라체.

decisions.choice: você, o seu Deus (the people to Jeremiah); o Deus de vocês (Jeremiah to the people)
decisions.reason: The people speak to Jeremiah with "você", as people speak to the prophet through the book, so "your God" is "o seu Deus". Jeremiah answers them with the plural "o Deus de vocês" (verse 4), and they then say "o nosso Deus" (verse 6): Portuguese keeps the shift of pronouns that m2 describes, through the chapter.

decisions.choice: the people speak to Jeremiah with "አንተ" ("በፊትህ", "አምላክህ", "ጸልይ"), the familiar address the Bible uses to a prophet.
decisions.reason: As the people address Elijah and Elisha in Kings; respect is carried by "እባክህ" and "ነቢዩ". The remnant is "ቅሬታ" (the terms list).

decisions.choice: आप to Jeremiah; भविष्यद्वक्ता (L, B), नबी (R)
decisions.reason: The commanders and the people ask a favour of the prophet and say आप to him; Jeremiah answers them with तुम. The prophet is भविष्यद्वक्ता at Literal and Balanced and नबी at Readable, as the history note sets it.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting in this chapter. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God comes from the honorific third person (वे, उनका). Recorded once for this file.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי הִנְנִ֧י מִתְפַּלֵּ֛ל אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם כְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וְֽהָיָ֡ה כָּֽל־הַדָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲנֶ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ אַגִּ֣יד לָכֶ֔ם לֹֽא־אֶמְנַ֥ע מִכֶּ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to them Jeremiah the prophet: I have heard; look, I [am] praying to Yahweh your God according to your words, and it will be, every word that answers Yahweh you, I will tell to you; not I will withhold from you a word.

en.L: And Jeremiah the prophet said to them, "I have heard. Look, I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God according to your words, and every word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answers you I will tell you; I will not hold back a word from you."
en.B: The prophet Jeremiah said to them, "I have heard you. I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God as you ask. Whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answers, I will tell you; I will not keep back a single word from you."
en.R: The prophet Jeremiah answered them, "I have heard you. I will pray to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God as you have asked. I will tell you everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answers. I will not hide anything from you."

es.L: Y Jeremías el profeta les dijo: «He oído. He aquí, voy a orar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} conforme a {{plural_you:sus palabras|vuestras palabras}}, y toda palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} responda, {{plural_you:se la|os la}} declararé; no {{plural_you:les|os}} ocultaré ni una palabra».
es.B: El profeta Jeremías les respondió: «{{plural_you:Los|Os}} he oído. Oraré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}} como {{plural_you:me piden|me pedís}}. Todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responda, {{plural_you:se lo|os lo}} diré; no {{plural_you:les|os}} ocultaré ni una sola palabra».
es.R: El profeta Jeremías les contestó: «{{plural_you:Los|Os}} he oído. Oraré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, como me lo {{plural_you:han pedido|habéis pedido}}. {{plural_you:Les|Os}} diré todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responda. No {{plural_you:les|os}} ocultaré nada».

fr.L: Et Jérémie le prophète leur dit : « J’ai entendu. Voici, je vais prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu selon vos paroles, et toute parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous répondra, je vous la ferai connaître ; je ne vous retiendrai pas une parole. »
fr.B: Le prophète Jérémie leur dit : « Je vous ai entendus. Je vais prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu comme vous le demandez. Tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondra, je vous le dirai ; je ne vous cacherai pas un seul mot. »
fr.R: Le prophète Jérémie leur a répondu : « Je vous ai entendus. Je vais prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu comme vous me l’avez demandé. Je vous dirai tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondra. Je ne vous cacherai rien. »

sw.L: Naye Yeremia nabii akawaambia, "Nimesikia. Tazama, nitamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu sawasawa na maneno yenu, na kila neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawajibu, nitawaambia; sitawazuilia neno lolote."
sw.B: Nabii Yeremia akawaambia, "Nimewasikia. Nitamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu kama mnavyoomba. Lolote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakalojibu, nitawaambia; sitawaficha hata neno moja."
sw.R: Nabii Yeremia akawajibu, "Nimewasikia. Nitamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu kama mlivyoomba. Nitawaambia kila kitu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakachojibu. Sitawaficha chochote."

vi.L: Nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi nói với họ: "Tôi đã nghe. Này, tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, theo lời anh em xin, và mọi lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp cho anh em, tôi sẽ nói cho anh em biết; tôi sẽ không giấu anh em một lời nào."
vi.B: Nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi nói với họ: "Tôi đã nghe anh em. Tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, như anh em xin. Hễ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp điều gì, tôi sẽ nói cho anh em biết; tôi sẽ không giấu anh em một lời nào."
vi.R: Nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi trả lời họ: "Tôi đã nghe anh em. Tôi sẽ cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, như anh em đã xin. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trả lời thế nào, tôi sẽ nói hết cho anh em biết. Tôi sẽ không giấu anh em điều gì."

ko.L: 그러자 예언자 예레미야가 그들에게 말했다. "내가 들었소. 보시오, 내가 여러분의 말대로 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하겠소. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 대답하시는 말씀은 모두 내가 여러분에게 알려 주겠소. 한 마디도 여러분에게 숨기지 않겠소."
ko.B: 예언자 예레미야가 그들에게 말했다. "잘 알았소. 여러분이 부탁한 대로 내가 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하겠소. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 무엇이라고 대답하시든지 내가 여러분에게 알려 주겠소. 한 마디도 빼놓지 않겠소."
ko.R: 예언자 예레미야가 대답했다. "알았소. 여러분이 부탁한 대로 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하겠소. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 대답하시는 것은 모두 여러분에게 말해 주겠소. 아무것도 숨기지 않겠소."

pt.R: O profeta Jeremias respondeu: "Eu ouvi vocês. Vou orar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, como vocês pediram. Vou contar a vocês tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} responder. Não vou esconder nada de vocês."

am.L: ነቢዩም ኤርምያስ እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ሰምቻለሁ፤ እነሆ፣ እንደ ቃላችሁ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እጸልያለሁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚመልስላችሁንም ቃል ሁሉ እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ከእናንተ አንድ ቃል አልከለክልም።»
am.B: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «ሰምቻችኋለሁ። እንደ ጠየቃችሁኝ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እጸልያለሁ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚመልሰውን ሁሉ እነግራችኋለሁ፤ አንዲት ቃል እንኳ ከእናንተ አልደብቅም።»
am.R: ነቢዩ ኤርምያስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰላቸው፦ «ሰምቻችኋለሁ። እንደ ጠየቃችሁኝ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እጸልያለሁ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚመልሰውን ሁሉ እነግራችኋለሁ። ምንም ነገር አልደብቃችሁም።»

hi.L: और भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह ने उनसे कहा, "मैंने सुन लिया है। देखो, मैं तुम्हारे वचनों के अनुसार तुम्हारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना करूँगा; और जो जो उत्तर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हें देंगे, वह सब मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगा; मैं तुमसे एक बात भी न छिपाऊँगा।"
hi.B: भविष्यद्वक्ता यिर्मयाह ने उनसे कहा, "मैंने तुम्हारी बात सुन ली है। मैं तुम्हारे कहने के अनुसार तुम्हारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना करूँगा। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जो भी उत्तर देंगे, वह मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगा; मैं तुमसे एक भी बात नहीं छिपाऊँगा।"
hi.R: नबी यिर्मयाह ने उन्हें उत्तर दिया, "मैंने तुम्हारी बात सुन ली है। जैसा तुमने कहा है, मैं तुम्हारे परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से प्रार्थना करूँगा। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जो भी उत्तर देंगे, वह सब मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगा। मैं तुमसे कुछ भी नहीं छिपाऊँगा।"

ru.L: И сказал им Иеремия, пророк: «Я услышал. Вот, я помолюсь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, по вашим словам; и будет: всякое слово, которое ответит вам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, я возвещу вам; не утаю от вас ни слова.»
ru.B: Пророк Иеремия сказал им: «Я вас услышал. Я помолюсь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, как вы просите. Что бы ни ответил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, я передам вам; не утаю от вас ни единого слова.»
ru.R: Пророк Иеремия ответил им: «Я вас услышал. Я помолюсь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вашему Богу, как вы просили. Я расскажу вам всё, что ответит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я ничего от вас не скрою.»

ja.L: そこで預言者エレミヤは彼らに言った。「聞いた。見なさい、わたしはあなたがたの言葉どおりに、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈る。そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたがたに答えられる言葉はすべて、あなたがたに告げる。一言も、あなたがたに隠しはしない。」
ja.B: 預言者エレミヤは彼らに言った。「よく分かった。あなたがたの願いどおり、あなたがたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ろう。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が答えられることは、何でもあなたがたに告げる。一言も隠しはしない。」
ja.R: 預言者エレミヤは答えました。「よく分かった。あなたたちが頼んだとおり、あなたたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に祈ろう。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が答えられることは、みなあなたたちに知らせる。何一つ隠したりはしない。」

uk.L: І сказав їм пророк Єремія: «Я почув. Ось я помолюся до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, згідно з вашими словами, і кожне слово, яке {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповість вам, я скажу вам; не втаю від вас ні слова».
uk.B: Пророк Єремія сказав їм: «Я почув вас. Я помолюся до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, як ви просите. Що б не відповів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, я скажу вам; не втаю від вас жодного слова».
uk.R: Пророк Єремія відповів їм: «Я почув вас. Я помолюся до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, вашого Бога, як ви просили. Я скажу вам усе, що відповість {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я нічого від вас не приховаю».

decisions.choice: the LORD your God: Jeremiah says "your" to all of them, claiming the LORD as the people's God too
decisions.reason: The people said "your God" to Jeremiah alone (verse 2). Jeremiah answers with the plural "your": the LORD is the God of all of them, not only of the prophet. In verse 6 they take this up and say "our God".

decisions.choice: look, I am praying: I will pray now, as a promise
decisions.reason: The word "look" with a participle announces what the speaker is about to do. Jeremiah agrees at once.

decisions.choice: I will not hold back a word: I will tell everything, whether you like it or not
decisions.reason: The verb means to withhold or keep back. Jeremiah promises to tell them the whole answer, as God told him at his call (1:7, 17) and in 26:2. Verses 19-22 show that the answer was not the one they wanted.

decisions.choice: as you ask (B); as you have asked (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "according to your words" means doing what they have asked.

decisions.choice: anh em (Jeremiah to the people)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "anh em" where the prophet pleads with the people, as in this chapter; it also lets "Đức Chúa Trời của anh em" claim the LORD as their God too.

decisions.choice: "вашему Богу"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah answers "your God", the plural, claiming the LORD as the people's God too (m1); Russian shows it with "вашему".

decisions.choice: Jeremiah answers the people plainly, with authority (JER-3 rule: 21:3); "あなたがたの神" (L, B), "あなたたちの神" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: Jeremiah says "your God" to all of them, claiming the LORD as the people's God too.

records.literal_gloss: And they said to Jeremiah: may be Yahweh against us as a witness of truth and faithful, if not according to all the word that sends you Yahweh your God to us, so we will do.

en.L: And they said to Jeremiah, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act according to every word with which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God sends you to us.
en.B: They said to Jeremiah, "If we fail to do all that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God sends you to tell us, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be a true and faithful witness against us.
en.R: They said to Jeremiah, "If we do not do everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God sends you to tell us, may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be a true and faithful witness against us.

fr.L: Et ils dirent à Jérémie : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit contre nous un témoin vrai et fidèle, si nous n’agissons pas selon toute parole avec laquelle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’enverra vers nous.

ru.B: Они сказали Иеремии: «Если мы не исполним всего, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, пошлёт тебя сказать нам, пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет против нас истинным и верным свидетелем.
ru.R: Они сказали Иеремии: «Если мы не сделаем всего, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, пошлёт тебя сказать нам, пусть {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} будет верным и надёжным свидетелем против нас.

uk.R: Вони сказали Єремії: «Якщо ми не зробимо всього, що {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, пошле тебе сказати нам, нехай {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} буде проти нас правдивим і вірним свідком.

decisions.choice: may the LORD be a witness against us: a solemn oath calling on God to judge them if they break their word
decisions.reason: An oath called God to witness, so that he would punish the one who did not keep it (Genesis 31:50; 1 Samuel 12:5; Micah 1:2). The people bind themselves in the strongest way they can, and verses 20-21 hold them to it.

decisions.choice: true and faithful: a witness who will tell exactly what happened and can be relied on
decisions.reason: The two words come from the same root, which speaks of what is firm and reliable. Together they describe a witness who cannot be mistaken or bribed.

decisions.choice: if not ... so we will do: a promise in the form of an oath, "if we do not do it"
decisions.reason: Hebrew oaths often state the condition and leave the curse unspoken, or put it first as here: may God witness against us if we do not act. The sense is a firm promise to obey.

decisions.choice: the condition first: If we fail to do (B) / If we do not do (R) ..., may the LORD be ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the "if" clause before the oath, so the long sentence reads more easily; the sense is unchanged (m3).

decisions.choice: the condition first at every level
decisions.reason: Hindi puts a यदि clause before its main clause; Literal does so too, though the English Literal keeps the Hebrew order. The words are the same.

decisions.choice: "истинным и верным свидетелем" (L, B); "верным и надёжным" (R)
decisions.reason: A witness who tells exactly what happened and can be relied on (m2); Literal and Balanced keep the pair of words that Revelation 3:14 uses in this translation in the other order.

decisions.choice: L puts the condition first as B and R do, since the verb of the wish must come last in Japanese.
alternatives: 主がわたしたちに対する証人となられますように。もし…
decisions.reason: m3: an oath in the form 'may the LORD be witness ... if we do not'.

records.literal_gloss: Whether good and whether bad, to [the] voice of Yahweh our God, whom we [are] sending you to him, we will listen, so that it may go well for us when we listen to [the] voice of Yahweh our God.

en.L: Whether good or bad, we will listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us when we listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God."
en.B: Whether we find it good or bad, we will obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, to whom we are sending you. When we obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, it will go well with us."
en.R: Whether we like the answer or not, we will obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. We are sending you to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. If we obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, things will go well for us."

es.L: Sea bueno o sea malo, escucharemos la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, a quien te enviamos, para que nos vaya bien cuando escuchemos la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios».
es.B: Nos parezca bien o mal, obedeceremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, a quien te enviamos. Cuando obedezcamos la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, nos irá bien».
es.R: Nos guste o no la respuesta, obedeceremos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. Te enviamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Si obedecemos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, nos irá bien».

fr.L: Que ce soit bon ou mauvais, nous écouterons la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, vers qui nous t’envoyons, afin que cela aille bien pour nous quand nous écouterons la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu. »
fr.B: Que la réponse nous plaise ou non, nous obéirons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu, vers qui nous t’envoyons. Si nous obéissons à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, tout ira bien pour nous. »
fr.R: Que la réponse nous plaise ou non, nous obéirons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu. C’est vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous t’envoyons. Si nous obéissons {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu, tout ira bien pour nous. »

sw.B: Tukiliona kuwa jema au baya, tutamtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, ambaye tunakutuma kwake. Tukiitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, mambo yatatuendea vema."

vi.L: Dù tốt hay xấu, chúng tôi sẽ nghe theo tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, là Đấng chúng tôi sai ông đến, để chúng tôi được phước khi nghe theo tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi."
vi.B: Dù điều đó tốt hay xấu đối với chúng tôi, chúng tôi cũng sẽ vâng theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, là Đấng chúng tôi sai ông đến. Khi chúng tôi vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, mọi sự sẽ tốt đẹp cho chúng tôi."
vi.R: Dù câu trả lời có vừa ý chúng tôi hay không, chúng tôi cũng sẽ vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi. Chúng tôi sai ông đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nếu chúng tôi vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi, mọi việc sẽ tốt đẹp cho chúng tôi."

ko.L: 좋든지 나쁘든지, 우리가 당신을 보내는 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣겠습니다. 우리가 우리 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 들을 때 우리가 잘될 것입니다."

am.L: መልካምም ቢሆን ክፉም ቢሆን፣ ወደ እርሱ የምንልክህን የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል እንሰማለን፤ የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል በሰማን ጊዜ መልካም ይሆንልን ዘንድ።»
am.B: ደስ ቢያሰኘንም ባያሰኘንም ወደ እርሱ የምንልክህን አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እንታዘዛለን። የአምላካችንን {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ስንታዘዝ መልካም ይሆንልናል።»
am.R: መልሱ ደስ ቢያሰኘንም ባያሰኘንም አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} እንታዘዛለን። ወደ እርሱ የምንልክህ ለዚህ ነው። አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ብንታዘዝ መልካም ይሆንልናል።»

hi.L: चाहे भला हो चाहे बुरा, हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात सुनेंगे, जिनके पास हम आपको भेज रहे हैं, कि जब हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात सुनें तो हमारा भला हो।"
hi.B: चाहे वह हमें भला लगे या बुरा, हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात मानेंगे, जिनके पास हम आपको भेज रहे हैं। जब हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात मानेंगे, तो हमारा भला होगा।"
hi.R: उत्तर हमें अच्छा लगे या न लगे, हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात मानेंगे। हम आपको उन्हीं के पास भेज रहे हैं। अगर हम अपने परमेश्वर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की बात मानेंगे, तो हमारा भला होगा।"

ru.L: Хорошо ли, худо ли — голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, к которому мы посылаем тебя, мы послушаем, чтобы было нам хорошо, когда послушаем голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога.»
ru.B: Хорошо это для нас или плохо, мы послушаемся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, к которому посылаем тебя. Когда мы будем слушаться голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, нам будет хорошо.»
ru.R: Понравится нам ответ или нет, мы послушаемся {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога. Мы посылаем тебя к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}}. Если мы будем слушаться {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, у нас всё будет хорошо.»

ja.L: 良くても悪くても、わたしたちがあなたを遣わすわたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に、わたしたちは聞き従います。わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従うとき、わたしたちが幸いを得るためです。」
ja.B: それが良いことでも悪いことでも、わたしたちはあなたを遣わして伺う、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従います。わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の声に聞き従えば、わたしたちは幸いを得るのです。」
ja.R: その答えが気に入っても気に入らなくても、わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に従います。わたしたちは、あなたをその方のところに遣わすのです。わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に従えば、わたしたちはうまくいくのです。」

uk.L: Чи добре, чи зле, ми послухаємо голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, до якого ми посилаємо тебе, щоб нам було добре, коли послухаємо голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога».
uk.B: Чи це буде нам до вподоби, чи ні, ми послухаємося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, до якого ми тебе посилаємо. Коли ми слухатимемося голосу {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, нам буде добре».
uk.R: Чи сподобається нам відповідь, чи ні, ми слухатимемося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога. Ми посилаємо тебе до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}. Якщо ми слухатимемося {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, у нас усе буде добре».

decisions.choice: whether good or bad: whether the answer pleases us or not
decisions.reason: Good and bad here describe how the answer will seem to them, welcome or unwelcome. The pair means "whatever it is".

decisions.choice: listen to the voice of the LORD: obey him
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to do what he says (7:23; 26:13). The phrase frames the verse, and verse 21 says they did not do it.

decisions.choice: we: the full form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have a short form of the word "we", found only rarely; the scribes marked the usual longer form to be read aloud (qere). Both mean the same.

decisions.choice: so that it may go well with us: the promise of the covenant
decisions.reason: The words echo the promises of Deuteronomy for those who obey (Deuteronomy 5:33; 6:3) and of Jeremiah 7:23. The people use them of themselves now; they turn on them in verses 20-22.

decisions.choice: obey
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m2). Readable also says "whether we like the answer or not" for "whether good or bad" (m1).

decisions.choice: Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi
alternatives: Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta
decisions.reason: The people speak to Jeremiah of "our God" as their own, excluding the listener in form; Vietnamese "chúng tôi" keeps their words as a pledge made to him.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span in the Amharic.
decisions.reason: Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic (docs/amharic-style.md section 7).

decisions.choice: की बात मानेंगे
decisions.reason: "Listen to the voice" means obey; Literal keeps सुनेंगे, Balanced and Readable say मानेंगे, as the English "obey".

decisions.choice: "послушаемся"
decisions.reason: To listen to the voice of the LORD is to obey him (m2); Balanced and Readable use "слушаться", the verb of obeying, and Literal keeps "голоса".

decisions.choice: shama' beqol "…の声に聞き従う" (L, B), "…に従う" (R).
decisions.reason: m2: obey; L, B keep 'voice' as the English B does not, since 声に聞き従う is the usual Japanese idiom for obeying God.

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת יָמִ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֶֽל־יִרְמְיָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was at [the] end of ten days, and came [the] word of Yahweh to Jeremiah.

en.L: And it came about at the end of ten days that the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah.
en.B: Ten days later the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Jeremiah.
en.R: Ten days later {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Jeremiah a message.

es.L: Y sucedió al cabo de diez días que vino la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Jeremías.
es.B: Diez días después, la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Jeremías.
es.R: Diez días después, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Jeremías un mensaje.

fr.L: Et il arriva, au bout de dix jours, que la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie.
fr.B: Dix jours plus tard, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Jérémie.
fr.R: Dix jours plus tard, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné un message à Jérémie.

sw.L: Ikawa mwisho wa siku kumi, neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Yeremia.
sw.B: Baada ya siku kumi neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Yeremia.
sw.R: Baada ya siku kumi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampa Yeremia ujumbe.

vi.L: Xảy ra, sau mười ngày, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi.
vi.B: Mười ngày sau, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi.
vi.R: Mười ngày sau, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Giê-rê-mi một sứ điệp.

ko.L: 그리고 열흘이 끝날 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예레미야에게 임했다.
ko.B: 열흘 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 예레미야에게 임했다.
ko.R: 열흘 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예레미야에게 말씀을 주셨다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, ao fim de dez dias, que a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio a Jeremias.
pt.B: Dez dias depois, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio a Jeremias.
pt.R: Dez dias depois, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu uma mensagem a Jeremias.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በአሥሩ ቀን መጨረሻ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።
am.B: ከአሥር ቀን በኋላ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ወደ ኤርምያስ መጣ።
am.R: ከአሥር ቀን በኋላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለኤርምያስ መልእክት ሰጠው።

hi.L: और दस दिन के अंत में ऐसा हुआ कि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा।
hi.B: दस दिन के बाद {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा।
hi.R: दस दिन के बाद {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यिर्मयाह को एक संदेश दिया।

ru.L: И было по прошествии десяти дней, и было слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} к Иеремии.
ru.B: Через десять дней {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} обратился к Иеремии.
ru.R: Через десять дней {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал Иеремии слово.

ja.L: そして十日の終わりに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がエレミヤに臨んだ。
ja.B: 十日後、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉がエレミヤに臨んだ。
ja.R: 十日後、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエレミヤに語られました。

uk.L: І сталося через десять днів, що було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до Єремії.
uk.B: Через десять днів було слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} до Єремії.
uk.R: Через десять днів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав Єремії послання.

decisions.choice: at the end of ten days: the answer came in God's time, not at once
decisions.reason: Jeremiah could not produce an answer on demand; he had to wait until God spoke (compare 28:11-12). The delay also gave the people time, and it shows that the answer did not come from Jeremiah's own opinion.

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah (L, B); the LORD gave Jeremiah a message (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula in Jeremiah, with Jeremiah's name in place of "me".

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन यिर्मयाह के पास पहुँचा (L, B); ... ने यिर्मयाह को एक संदेश दिया (R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's formula for "the word of the LORD came to X".

decisions.choice: "было слово ГОСПОДА к Иеремии" (L); "ГОСПОДЬ обратился к Иеремии" (B); "ГОСПОДЬ дал Иеремии слово" (R)
decisions.reason: The Prophets note's formula for each level, with Jeremiah's name in place of "me"; Readable leaves out "такое", since the message does not follow at once.

decisions.choice: The JER formula in the third person: "主の言葉がエレミヤに臨んだ" (L, B), "主はエレミヤに語られました" (R).
decisions.reason: JER-1 conventions.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶל־יֽוֹחָנָן֙ בֶּן־קָרֵ֔חַ וְאֶ֛ל כָּל־שָׂרֵ֥י הַחֲיָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וּלְכָ֨ל־הָעָ֔ם לְמִקָּטֹ֥ן וְעַד־גָּדֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he called to Johanan son of Kareah and to all [the] commanders of the forces who [were] with him, and to all the people from small and unto great.

en.L: And he called Johanan son of Kareah, and all the commanders of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the small to the great,
en.B: So he summoned Johanan son of Kareah and all the commanders of the forces who were with him. He summoned all the people as well, from the least to the greatest.
en.R: So Jeremiah called for Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders who were with him. He also called all the people, from the least important to the most important.

es.L: Y llamó a Johanán hijo de Carea, y a todos los jefes de las tropas que [estaban] con él, y a todo el pueblo, desde el menor hasta el mayor,
es.B: Entonces llamó a Johanán hijo de Carea y a todos los jefes de las tropas que estaban con él. Llamó también a todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande.
es.R: Así que Jeremías llamó a Johanán hijo de Carea y a todos los jefes del ejército que estaban con él. También llamó a todo el pueblo, desde el menos importante hasta el más importante.

fr.L: Et il appela Yohanân fils de Qaréah, et tous les chefs des troupes qui étaient avec lui, et tout le peuple, du plus petit jusqu’au plus grand,
fr.B: Il convoqua donc Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs des troupes qui étaient avec lui. Il convoqua aussi tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand.
fr.R: Jérémie a donc fait venir Yohanân fils de Qaréah et tous les chefs de l’armée qui étaient avec lui. Il a aussi fait venir tout le peuple, des plus humbles aux plus importants.

sw.L: Naye akamwita Yohana mwana wa Karea, na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye, na watu wote tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa,
sw.B: Basi akamwita Yohana mwana wa Karea na wakuu wote wa majeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye. Akawaita pia watu wote, tangu aliye mdogo hadi aliye mkubwa.
sw.R: Basi Yeremia akamwita Yohana mwana wa Karea na makamanda wote wa jeshi waliokuwa pamoja naye. Akawaita pia watu wote, tangu wasio na cheo hadi wenye vyeo vikubwa.

vi.L: Ông gọi Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át, tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông ta, và cả dân chúng từ nhỏ đến lớn,
vi.B: Vậy ông triệu tập Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính ở với ông ta. Ông cũng triệu tập cả dân chúng, từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất.
vi.R: Vậy Giê-rê-mi cho gọi Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át và tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân đội ở với ông ta. Ông cũng gọi cả dân chúng, từ người thấp hèn nhất đến người quan trọng nhất.

ko.L: 그래서 그가 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관과 작은 자부터 큰 자까지 모든 백성을 불러,
ko.B: 그래서 예레미야는 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관을 불렀다. 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성도 불렀다.
ko.R: 그래서 예레미야는 가레아의 아들 요하난과 그와 함께 있던 모든 군대 지휘관을 불렀다. 지위가 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성도 불렀다.

pt.L: E ele chamou Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os chefes das tropas que estavam com ele, e todo o povo, desde o pequeno até o grande,
pt.B: Então ele chamou Joanã, filho de Careá, e todos os comandantes das tropas que estavam com ele. Chamou também todo o povo, do menor ao maior.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah's speech runs from here to the end of the chapter
decisions.reason: Jeremiah speaks from verse 9 to verse 22. In verses 9-18 he gives God's answer, in which God speaks of himself as "I"; in verses 19-22 he speaks in his own voice and warns them (43:1 says he then finished speaking).

decisions.choice: to lay your plea before him: the same picture as in verse 2
decisions.reason: The people asked that their plea "fall" before Jeremiah (verse 2); here the causative form of the same verb says that Jeremiah made it fall, that is, laid it, before God. He reminds them that the answer is to their own request.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (L); he says this (B); This is what the LORD ... says (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula in Isaiah and Jeremiah. Balanced puts the clause "to whom you sent me" first, so that the long title does not stand between the LORD and "says this". As in 28:16, God's words given by the prophet inside his own speech take no further quotation marks.

decisions.choice: You sent me to him with your request, and this is his answer
decisions.reason: Readable puts the relative clause in a sentence of its own and supplies "this is his answer" to lead into verse 10.

decisions.choice: Así dice el SEÑOR (L); él dice esto (B); Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula set for the prophets, fitted to the sentence as the English does.

decisions.choice: "이와 같이 말씀하시오" (L), "이렇게 말씀하시오" (B), "하시는 말씀이오" (R): the formula in Jeremiah's 하오체
decisions.reason: The formula belongs to Jeremiah's own address to the assembly, so it takes his register; God's words that follow are 해라체.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ... यों कहते हैं (L); ... यह कहते हैं (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula "Thus says the LORD" as the terms note sets it: यों कहते हैं at Literal, यह कहते हैं at Balanced and Readable, as 1-2 Kings.

decisions.choice: "Так говорит ГОСПОДЬ" (L, B); "Вот что говорит ГОСПОДЬ" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula in the Prophets note's wording for each level. Balanced keeps the formula first, where the English Balanced puts the relative clause first.

decisions.choice: koh 'amar YHWH "主はこう言われる" (every level); Jeremiah speaks to the people plain; God's message that follows (42:10-18) is plain at every level, in oracle forms (恐れるな / 恐れてはならない / 恐れてはいけない).
decisions.reason: JER conventions: the prophet's speech to the people plain; God's words inside it plain.

decisions.choice: "その方" for "him" and "his" ("その方のところに", "その方のお答え").
decisions.reason: Never 彼 for God; その方 keeps the divine-name count of the English.

decisions.choice: if you will indeed stay: the doubled verb stresses the condition
alternatives: if you will return and stay
decisions.reason: Hebrew strengthens a verb by putting a form of the same verb before it. Here the first word is spelled as if from the verb "return", while the second is "stay". It is best taken as a spelling of the same verb "stay", with one letter dropped, since the whole verse is about remaining in the land (verse 13). Reading it as "return" would give "if you will go back and stay", that is, give up the road to Egypt (41:17).

decisions.choice: build, tear down, plant, uproot: the verbs of Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: These are words from 1:10, where Jeremiah is set over the nations "to uproot and to tear down ... to build and to plant". As in 24:6, only building and planting are promised, and tearing down and uprooting are ruled out, but here the promise depends on the people staying in the land.

decisions.choice: I relent concerning the disaster: God grieves over the judgment he has carried out and turns from it
alternatives: I am sorry for the disaster
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 18:8 and 26:3, where God says he will relent from a disaster he has announced. Here the disaster has already happened: the fall of Jerusalem. The verb also carries the sense of being moved to pity or grieved (Judges 2:18; 2 Samuel 24:16). God is not saying that the judgment was wrong (Numbers 23:19), but that he takes no pleasure in it and has now turned from it, so that he can build and plant again.

decisions.choice: build ... and not tear down ... plant ... and not uproot
decisions.reason: The verbs of 1:10 keep their wording at each level, worded as in 24:6. Balanced and Readable join the two halves with "and", as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: grieves me, and I have relented
decisions.reason: In 18:8 and 26:3 Readable says "change my mind" about a disaster not yet sent. Here it has already come, so Readable names both senses of the verb (m3): grief over the disaster and turning from it. "Relented" is kept from Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: edificar ... derribar ... plantar ... arrancar
decisions.reason: The words of 1:10, kept the same each time they return in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: me pesa (L, B); Me duele ... y he cambiado de parecer (R)
decisions.reason: God relenting (nicham) is never "arrepentirse" in this translation. Here the disaster has already come and the verb carries grief over it (meaning decision m3), so Literal and Balanced say "me pesa", as 1 Samuel 15:11 Literal; elsewhere in Jeremiah Literal says "retractarse".

decisions.choice: "kujenga ... kubomoa ... kupanda ... kung'oa" at every level
decisions.reason: The four verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10) are kept the same each time they return, so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: nimeghairi (L, B); nimebadili nia yangu (R)
decisions.reason: God relenting (*niḥam*) has one wording in Jeremiah: "kughairi" at Literal and Balanced, "kubadili nia" at Readable, as 4:28, 18:8, 10 and 26:3, 13, 19.

decisions.choice: "je renonce au malheur" (L, B), as 18:8 and 26:3
decisions.reason: God relenting (*niḥam*) is "renoncer à" at Literal and Balanced throughout Jeremiah, as Exodus 32:14 in French ("se repentir" would suggest turning from sin); Readable names the grief and the turning, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "bâtir ... démolir ... planter ... arracher"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah’s call (1:10), kept the same each time they return.

decisions.choice: xây dựng ... phá đổ ... trồng ... nhổ đi
decisions.reason: The four verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10), kept the same at every level so the echo can be heard. God's message to the people says "các ngươi".

decisions.choice: đổi ý (L, B); đau lòng ... và đã đổi ý (R)
decisions.reason: God "relents": he turns from the judgment, grieving over it. "Hối hận" would suggest he had done wrong; Readable adds the grief, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "세우다 / 허물다 / 심다 / 뽑다"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10), kept the same each time they return, as the English Jeremiah note asks.

decisions.choice: "뜻을 돌이키다" for *nicham*
decisions.reason: "후회하다" would suggest God admits a mistake; "뜻을 돌이키다" says he turns from the judgment, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: desisto da desgraça (L, B); me causa dor, e eu voltei atrás (R)
decisions.reason: The verb keeps "desistir de", the wording 4:28 sets at Literal and Balanced, where "arrepender-se" would suggest that God had done wrong. Here the disaster has already come (m3), so Readable names both senses, grief and turning back, as the English Readable does. The verbs of 1:10 keep the words set there: "construir", "derrubar", "plantar", "arrancar".

decisions.choice: build / tear down / plant / uproot are "እሠራችኋለሁ … አላፈርሳችሁም፤ እተክላችኋለሁ … አልነቅላችሁም"; "I relent" (niḥam) is "ተጸጽቻለሁ" (Literal, Balanced), "ሐሳቤን ለውጫለሁ" (Readable).
decisions.reason: The four verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10) recur through the book and should keep one Amharic wording; "ተጸጸተ" is the word of Exodus 32:12 and Psalm 110:4 on main.

decisions.choice: बनाना, ढाना, रोपना, उखाड़ना
decisions.reason: The four verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10) in the Hindi of that verse, so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: पछताता हूँ (L, B); मुझे दुख है, और मैंने अपना मन बदल लिया है (R)
decisions.reason: God relenting (niham): Literal and Balanced use the usual Hindi verb, Readable says it in two plain parts, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "построю ... не низвергну, насажу ... не искореню" (L, B); "посажу ... не вырву с корнем" (R)
decisions.reason: The verbs of 1:10 keep the Russian of that verse at each level, so that the echo of Jeremiah's call is heard (m2).

decisions.choice: "сожалею о бедствии" (L, B); "огорчает меня, и я отступил от гнева" (R)
decisions.reason: God grieves over the judgment already carried out and turns from it (m3); "раскаиваюсь" would suggest a wrong done, so Literal and Balanced say "сожалею".

decisions.choice: The verbs of the call: banah "建てる", haras "打ち倒す", nata' "植える", natash "引き抜く" (every level, JER.1.10).
decisions.reason: m2: the six verbs keep one Japanese form through the book.

decisions.choice: nichamti "思い直した" (L, B), "心を痛め、思い直した" (R).
decisions.reason: m3: God grieves over the judgment and turns from it; 悔いる suggests remorse for a wrong.

records.literal_gloss: Not be afraid of [the] face of [the] king of Babylon whom you [are] afraid of his face; not be afraid of him, declares Yahweh, for with you [am] I to save you and to deliver you from his hand.

en.L: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; do not be afraid of him, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for I am with you to save you and to deliver you from his hand.
en.B: Do not fear the king of Babylon, though you are afraid of him now. Do not fear him, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I am with you, and I will save you and rescue you from his power.
en.R: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon. I know you fear him, but do not be afraid of him, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I am with you. I will save you and rescue you from his power.

es.L: No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}} al rey de Babilonia, de quien {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} miedo; no lo {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:salvarlos|salvaros}} y {{plural_you:librarlos|libraros}} de su mano.
es.B: No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}} al rey de Babilonia, aunque ahora le {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. No lo {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} salvaré y {{plural_you:los|os}} libraré de su poder.
es.R: No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo del rey de Babilonia. Sé que le {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} miedo, pero no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de él, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Yo estoy con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} salvaré y {{plural_you:los|os}} libraré de su poder.

fr.L: N’ayez pas peur du roi de Babylone, dont vous avez peur ; n’ayez pas peur de lui, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je suis avec vous pour vous sauver et pour vous délivrer de sa main.
fr.B: Ne craignez pas le roi de Babylone, même si vous en avez peur maintenant. Ne le craignez pas, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je suis avec vous, je vous sauverai et je vous délivrerai de son pouvoir.
fr.R: N’ayez pas peur du roi de Babylone. Je sais que vous le craignez, mais n’ayez pas peur de lui, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je suis avec vous. Je vous sauverai et je vous délivrerai de son pouvoir.

sw.L: Msimwogope mfalme wa Babeli, mnayemwogopa; msimwogope, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana mimi niko pamoja nanyi ili kuwaokoa na kuwaponya na mkono wake.
sw.B: Msimwogope mfalme wa Babeli, ingawa sasa mnamwogopa. Msimwogope, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mimi niko pamoja nanyi, nami nitawaokoa na kuwaponya na mamlaka yake.
sw.R: Msimwogope mfalme wa Babeli. Najua mnamwogopa, lakini msimwogope, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mimi niko pamoja nanyi. Nitawaokoa na kuwaponya na mamlaka yake.

vi.L: Đừng sợ vua Ba-by-lôn, là kẻ các ngươi đang sợ; đừng sợ nó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với các ngươi để cứu các ngươi và giải thoát các ngươi khỏi tay nó.
vi.B: Đừng sợ vua Ba-by-lôn, dù hiện giờ các ngươi đang sợ nó. Đừng sợ nó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Ta ở với các ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu các ngươi, giải thoát các ngươi khỏi quyền lực của nó.
vi.R: Đừng sợ vua Ba-by-lôn. Ta biết các ngươi sợ nó, nhưng đừng sợ nó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta ở với các ngươi. Ta sẽ cứu các ngươi và giải thoát các ngươi khỏi quyền lực của nó.

ko.L: 너희가 두려워하는 바빌론 왕을 두려워하지 마라. 그를 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 너희와 함께 있어 너희를 구원하고 그의 손에서 너희를 건져 내겠다.
ko.B: 너희가 지금 두려워하는 바빌론 왕을 두려워하지 마라. 그를 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 너희와 함께 있어서 너희를 구원하고 그의 손에서 건져 내겠다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕을 두려워하지 마라. 너희가 그를 두려워하는 줄 안다. 그러나 그를 두려워하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 너희와 함께 있다. 내가 너희를 구원하고 그의 손에서 구해 내겠다.

pt.L: Não tenham medo do rei da Babilônia, de quem vocês têm medo; não tenham medo dele, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque eu estou com vocês para salvá-los e para livrá-los da mão dele.
pt.B: Não temam o rei da Babilônia, embora agora tenham medo dele. Não o temam, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Eu estou com vocês e vou salvá-los e resgatá-los do poder dele.
pt.R: Não tenham medo do rei da Babilônia. Eu sei que vocês o temem, mas não tenham medo dele, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Eu estou com vocês. Vou salvar vocês e resgatá-los do poder dele.

am.L: የምትፈሩትን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አትፍሩ፤ አትፍሩት፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ላድናችሁና ከእጁ ላስጥላችሁ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና።
am.B: አሁን የምትፈሩትን የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አትፍሩ። አትፍሩት፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ፤ አድናችኋለሁ፤ ከሥልጣኑም አስጥላችኋለሁ።
am.R: የባቢሎንን ንጉሥ አትፍሩ። እንደምትፈሩት አውቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አትፍሩት፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ። አድናችኋለሁ፤ ከሥልጣኑም አስጥላችኋለሁ።

hi.L: बाबुल के राजा से मत डरो, जिससे तुम डरते हो; उससे मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, क्योंकि तुम्हें बचाने और उसके हाथ से छुड़ाने को मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ।
hi.B: बाबुल के राजा से मत डरो, यद्यपि अभी तुम उससे डरते हो। उससे मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है। मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ; मैं तुम्हें बचाऊँगा और उसके हाथ से छुड़ाऊँगा।
hi.R: बाबुल के राजा से मत डरो। मैं जानता हूँ कि तुम उससे डरते हो, पर उससे मत डरो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। मैं तुम्हारे साथ हूँ। मैं तुम्हें बचाऊँगा और उसकी शक्ति से छुड़ाऊँगा।

ru.L: Не бойтесь царя Вавилона, которого вы боитесь; не бойтесь его, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} с вами, чтобы спасать вас и избавлять вас от его руки.
ru.B: Не бойтесь царя Вавилона, хотя сейчас вы его боитесь. Не бойтесь его, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. — Я с вами, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу вас и избавлю от его власти.
ru.R: Не бойтесь царя Вавилона. Я знаю, что вы его боитесь, но не бойтесь его, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. — Я с вами. Я спасу вас и избавлю от его власти.

ja.L: あなたがたが恐れているバビロンの王を恐れるな。彼を恐れるな――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。わたしがあなたがたと共にいて、あなたがたを救い、彼の手から救い出すからだ。
ja.B: あなたがたは今バビロンの王を恐れているが、彼を恐れてはならない。彼を恐れてはならない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。わたしがあなたがたと共にいて、あなたがたを救い、彼の手から助け出すからだ。
ja.R: バビロンの王を恐れてはいけない。あなたたちが王を恐れているのは分かっている。しかし、恐れてはいけない、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。わたしがあなたたちと一緒にいる。わたしがあなたたちを救い、王の手から守る。

uk.L: Не бійтеся царя Вавилону, якого ви боїтеся; не бійтеся його, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} з вами, щоб спасати вас і визволяти вас з його руки.
uk.B: Не бійтеся царя Вавилону, хоч ви тепер і боїтеся його. Не бійтеся його, говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я з вами, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} спасу вас і визволю вас з його влади.
uk.R: Не бійтеся вавилонського царя. Я знаю, що ви його боїтеся, але не бійтеся його, каже {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}. Я з вами. Я врятую вас і визволю вас з його влади.

decisions.choice: the fear of the king of Babylon: they expected him to punish them for the murder of his governor
decisions.reason: Ishmael had killed Gedaliah, whom Nebuchadnezzar had set over the land, and the Babylonian soldiers with him (41:2-3). Johanan and the others feared that the king would take revenge on all who were left (41:18).

decisions.choice: I am with you to save you and to deliver you: the promise once given to Jeremiah, now given to the people
decisions.reason: God made the same promise to Jeremiah at his call and when he complained (1:8, 19; 15:20). Now it is offered to the whole remnant, as in 30:10-11, if they stay.

decisions.choice: from his hand: from his power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control.

decisions.choice: his power
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom (m3). Readable also says "I know you fear him" to keep the repeated fear of the Hebrew in plain words.

decisions.choice: eu estou com vocês para salvá-los e para livrá-los (L); resgatá-los (B, R)
decisions.reason: God gives the people the promise he gave Jeremiah at his call (m2), in the words 1:8 and 1:19 use in Portuguese, now with the plural "vocês": "livrar" at Literal, "resgatar" at Balanced; Readable says "resgatar", as the English Readable says "rescue" here.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: "Declares the LORD" in the prophets note's wording for each level.

decisions.choice: "от его власти"
decisions.reason: "From his hand" means from his power (m3); Literal keeps "руки".

decisions.choice: ne'um YHWH mid-sentence "――主の言葉――" (L), "と主は告げる" (B), "と主は言う" (R); hatsil "救い出す" (L), "助け出す" (B), "守る" (R) (JER.1.8, 1.19).
decisions.reason: m2: the promise once given to Jeremiah (1:8, 1:19), in the same words.

records.literal_gloss: And I will give to you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and he will return you to your soil.

en.L: And I will grant you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and bring you back to your own soil.
en.B: I will grant you compassion, so that he will have compassion on you and let you return to your own land.
en.R: I will make the king show you mercy. He will be kind to you and let you go back to your own land.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} daré compasión, y él tendrá compasión de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} hará volver a {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}.

es.R: Haré que el rey tenga compasión de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Será bueno con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y {{plural_you:los|os}} dejará volver a {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}.

sw.R: Nitamfanya mfalme awaonyeshe huruma. Atawatendea wema na kuwaruhusu mrudi katika nchi yenu.

hi.L: और मैं तुम पर दया करवाऊँगा, और वह तुम पर दया करेगा और तुम्हें तुम्हारी भूमि पर लौटा देगा।

ru.B: Я сделаю так, что вы найдёте милосердие, и он сжалится над вами и позволит вам вернуться на вашу землю.
ru.R: Я сделаю так, что царь будет милостив к вам. Он будет добр к вам и позволит вам вернуться на свою землю.

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたにあわれみを与え、彼はあなたがたをあわれみ、あなたがたをあなたがたの土地に帰らせる。
ja.B: わたしがあなたがたにあわれみを施すので、彼はあなたがたをあわれみ、あなたがたを自分の土地に帰らせる。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам вам милосердя, і він змилосердиться над вами і поверне вас на вашу землю.
uk.B: Я виявлю вам милосердя, тож і він змилосердиться над вами й дозволить вам повернутися до своєї землі.
uk.R: Я зроблю так, що цар виявить вам милість. Він буде добрий до вас і дозволить вам повернутися до своєї землі.

decisions.choice: I will grant you compassion: I will cause you to find compassion from the king
decisions.reason: To "give someone compassion" is to make others treat him with pity (1 Kings 8:50; Nehemiah 1:11; Psalm 106:46). God will move the king of Babylon to be kind to them.

decisions.choice: he will bring you back, as the Hebrew reads
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "he will cause you to return". Since the people are still in the land, a change of one vowel would give "he will let you stay" (from the verb "stay" in verse 10), and the Greek translation is said to read "I will bring you back". The Hebrew makes sense as it stands: the people had fled from Mizpah and were camped on the road to Egypt (41:16-17), and many had scattered to nearby lands (40:11-12). The king will let them go back to their homes. The description of the Greek is from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: your own soil: the farmland of their own homes
decisions.reason: The word is the ground that is farmed, not only the country. It fits the promise to plant them (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the king; be kind to you
decisions.reason: Readable names the king, whom "he" refers to (verse 11), and spreads "compassion" over "mercy" and "kind".

decisions.choice: तुम पर दया करवाऊँगा
decisions.reason: "I will give you compassion" means God will move the king to show it; the causative दया करवाऊँगा says that in natural Hindi without naming the king, which Readable does.

decisions.choice: "сделаю так, что вы найдёте милосердие"
decisions.reason: "I will give you compassion" means that God will make the king show it (m1); Balanced says so, and Literal keeps the Hebrew words.

decisions.choice: rachamim / richam "あわれみ / あわれむ" (kana, as the style guide); R "優しくし" by the English R.
decisions.reason: m1: God causes the king to show compassion.

source.text: וְאִם־אֹמְרִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לֹ֥א נֵשֵׁ֖ב בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את לְבִלְתִּ֣י שְׁמֹ֔עַ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if [are] saying you: not we will stay in the land the this, so as not to listen to [the] voice of Yahweh your God,

en.L: But if you say, 'We will not stay in this land,' so as not to listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God,
en.B: But suppose you say, 'We will not stay in this land,' and so disobey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God,
en.R: But you may say, 'We will not stay in this land.' You may refuse to obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Pero si {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “No nos quedaremos en esta tierra”, para no escuchar la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}},

es.R: Pero tal vez {{plural_you:digan|digáis}}: “No nos quedaremos en esta tierra”. Tal vez se {{plural_you:nieguen|neguéis}} a obedecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

fr.L: Mais si vous dites : “Nous ne demeurerons pas dans ce pays”, pour ne pas écouter la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu,
fr.B: Mais supposons que vous disiez : “Nous ne resterons pas dans ce pays”, et que vous désobéissiez ainsi à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu,
fr.R: Mais vous direz peut-être : “Nous ne resterons pas dans ce pays.” Vous refuserez peut-être d’obéir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

sw.L: Lakini mkisema, 'Hatutakaa katika nchi hii,' hata msiisikilize sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu,

ru.L: А если вы скажете: “Не останемся мы в этой земле”, чтобы не слушать голоса {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, вашего Бога,

decisions.choice: but if you say: the second choice, set against verses 10-12
decisions.reason: Verse 10 began "if you stay"; here begins the other path. The condition runs through verses 13-15, and the result is given in verses 16-17.

decisions.choice: so as not to listen to the voice of the LORD: refusing to obey him
decisions.reason: Saying "we will not stay" would itself be the refusal to obey. The words recall the people's oath in verse 6.

decisions.choice: a comma at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on through verses 14-16. Readable uses short sentences and picks up the condition again in verse 15.

decisions.choice: single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The words the people might say are quoted inside Jeremiah's speech, which is already in double quotation marks.

decisions.choice: The people's imagined words in 『』 inside Jeremiah's 「」.
decisions.reason: The nesting of the style guide; the English has single quotation marks.

source.text: לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹ֚א כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ נָב֔וֹא אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־נִרְאֶה֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָ֖ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁמָ֑ע וְלַלֶּ֥חֶם לֹֽא־נִרְעָ֖ב וְשָׁ֥ם נֵשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: saying: no, for [the] land of Egypt we will go, where not we will see war, and [the] sound of [the] shofar not we will hear, and for bread not we will hunger, and there we will stay,

en.L: saying, 'No, but to the land of Egypt we will go, where we will not see war or hear the sound of the trumpet or be hungry for bread, and there we will stay,'
en.B: and say, 'No, we will go to the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, hear no ram's horn sounding and never go hungry for bread. That is where we will live,'

es.L: diciendo: “No, sino que iremos a la tierra de Egipto, donde no veremos guerra, ni oiremos sonido de trompeta, ni tendremos hambre de pan, y allí habitaremos”,
es.B: y {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “No, iremos a la tierra de Egipto, donde no veremos guerra, no oiremos el sonido del cuerno de carnero y nunca pasaremos hambre. Allí es donde viviremos”,

fr.L: disant : “Non, mais c’est au pays d’Égypte que nous irons, où nous ne verrons pas la guerre et n’entendrons pas le son du cor et n’aurons pas faim de pain, et là nous demeurerons”,
fr.B: et que vous disiez : “Non, nous irons au pays d’Égypte, où nous ne verrons pas de guerre, n’entendrons pas sonner le cor et ne manquerons jamais de pain. C’est là que nous habiterons”,
fr.R: Vous direz peut-être : “Non ! Nous irons en Égypte. Là, nous ne verrons pas la guerre et nous n’entendrons pas la trompette qui appelle au combat. Nous n’aurons jamais faim là-bas. C’est là que nous habiterons.”

ko.L: '아니다, 우리는 전쟁을 보지 않고 나팔 소리를 듣지 않고 빵에 굶주리지 않을 이집트 땅으로 가서 거기에 머무르겠다' 하고 말한다면,

ja.L: 『いや、わたしたちはエジプトの地へ行く。そこでは戦いを見ず、角笛の音を聞かず、パンに飢えることもない。そこにわたしたちは住む』と言うなら、

uk.L: кажучи: “Ні, але до землі Єгипту підемо, де не побачимо війни і не почуємо голосу сурми і не голодуватимемо без хліба, і там житимемо”,
uk.B: і скажете: “Ні, ми підемо до єгипетської землі, де не побачимо війни, не почуємо звуку рогу й ніколи не голодуватимемо без хліба. Там ми й житимемо”,

decisions.choice: the sound of the shofar: the alarm that warned of an enemy attack
decisions.reason: The ram's horn was blown to warn of an invading army and to call men to battle (4:5, 19, 21; 6:1). The people want a land where they will never hear it again.

decisions.choice: no, but: a strong refusal followed by the plan they choose instead
decisions.reason: The word "no" answers God's offer to stay, and the next word sets their own plan against it.

decisions.choice: going back to Egypt: turning back the way of the exodus
decisions.reason: Egypt was the land God had brought Israel out of, and the Law warned against going back there (Deuteronomy 17:16; 28:68). The people hope it will be a place of safety and plenty, as it had been in Joseph's time (Genesis 42:1-2). Verses 16-17 answer each of their hopes.

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R); ram's horn (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the shofar, as in Isaiah. Readable adds "call to battle" to say what the sound meant (m1).

decisions.choice: That is where we will live
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts "there" first for stress; Balanced and Readable give the stress with a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: trompeta (L, R); cuerno de carnero (B)
decisions.reason: The *shofar* is a ram's horn blown as an alarm in war; Balanced names it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: baragumu
decisions.reason: The *shofar*, the ram's horn blown as the alarm of war, is "baragumu" at every level, as in 4:5-21 and 6:1, 17; Readable says what it called people to ("ikiita vitani").

decisions.choice: tiếng tù và báo động (B); tiếng kèn (L); tiếng kèn gọi ra trận (R)
decisions.reason: The *shofar* is a ram's horn sounded to warn of attack; Balanced names it as a horn of alarm, Readable gives its use.

decisions.choice: "나팔" (L, R); "숫양 뿔 나팔" (B) for the *shofar*
decisions.reason: Balanced names the ram's horn as the English does; Readable adds what the call meant.

decisions.choice: o chifre de carneiro (L, B); a trombeta (R)
decisions.reason: The ram's horn (m1) keeps the wording 4:5 sets for the book; Readable adds what the sound meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the shofar is "መለከት" (Literal, Readable) and "የቀንድ መለከት" (Balanced), as the Kings terms list.
decisions.reason: Readable adds what it was for ("ለጦርነት የሚጠራ"), as the English Readable and the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: नरसिंगा (L); मेढ़े का सींग (B); तुरही (R)
decisions.reason: The shofar is नरसिंगा, as the Psalms forms; Balanced names what it is made of and Readable uses the everyday word for a call to battle, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "звук трубы" (L); "звук рога" (B); "труба, зовущая на битву" (R)
decisions.reason: The shofar takes the words of Jeremiah 4 and 6 in this translation at each level; it sounded the alarm of an attack (m1).

decisions.choice: shofar "角笛" at every level, as JER.4.5, though the English L and R say "trumpet".
decisions.reason: m1: the alarm horn; the book keeps one word for shofar.

records.literal_gloss: and now, therefore, hear [the] word of Yahweh, remnant of Judah: thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: if you setting will set your faces to go [to] Egypt and you go to sojourn there,

en.L: then now, therefore, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, remnant of Judah. Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: If you indeed set your faces to go to Egypt, and you go to sojourn there,
en.B: then hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, remnant of Judah. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: If you are set on going to Egypt, and you go to settle there,
en.R: If you do that, then listen to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s message, you people who are left from Judah. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: If you have made up your minds to go to Egypt and live there,

es.L: ahora, pues, {{plural_you:oigan|oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, remanente de Judá. Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Si de veras {{plural_you:se empeñan|os empeñáis}} en ir a Egipto, y {{plural_you:van|vais}} a residir allí como forasteros,
es.B: entonces {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, remanente de Judá. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: Si {{plural_you:están|estáis}} decididos a ir a Egipto, y {{plural_you:van|vais}} a establecerse allí,
es.R: Si {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} eso, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los que quedan de Judá. Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: Si {{plural_you:han decidido|habéis decidido}} ir a vivir a Egipto,

fr.L: alors maintenant, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, reste de Juda. Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Si vous tournez vraiment vos faces pour aller en Égypte, et si vous y allez pour y séjourner en étrangers,
fr.B: alors écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, reste de Juda. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Si vous êtes décidés à aller en Égypte, et que vous y alliez pour vous y installer,
fr.R: Si vous faites cela, alors écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, vous qui restez de Juda. Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Si vous avez décidé d’aller vivre en Égypte,

sw.B: basi sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi mabaki ya Yuda. Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Ikiwa mmekusudia kwenda Misri, nanyi mkaenda kuishi huko,
sw.R: Mkifanya hivyo, basi sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watu mliobaki kutoka Yuda. Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Ikiwa mmeamua kwenda Misri na kuishi huko,
